The short answer on sick leave or fitness certificates

You need a sick leave certificate if you were too unwell to work or study, and a fitness certificate if an organisation needs proof you are fit to work, study, play sport or fly. On DrCertificate, an independent registered doctor reviews your request and decides whether to issue either one. The service suits non emergency situations only.
Before you apply
What should you know first?

blocks.text: What is a sick leave or fitness certificate?

A sick leave certificate is a doctor's statement that you were unwell and unfit for work or study on stated dates. A fitness certificate is a doctor's statement that you are fit for a stated purpose, like starting a job, joining a sports club or flying.
Neither certificate lists your full medical history.
A sick leave note does not say you are fit to return. A fitness note does not excuse past absence.

On the DrCertificate form, choose the Sick Leave option for university or work if you need time off covered. A general medical certificate uses that same option. Choose the Medical Fitness Certificate option for employee, student, sports, fit to work or fit to fly needs.

Two lookalikes cause confusion. A work from home certificate says you can work but should stay home, and an unfit to travel certificate says you should not fly. Both have their own options on the form.

blocks.text: When do you need a sick leave or fitness certificate?

items: You need a sick leave certificate when an employer, university or school asks you to prove an absence was due to illness. You need a fitness certificate when they want proof you are well enough to start or continue something. The person asking is usually HR, a school office, a coach or an airline.

Sick leave notes come up after a missed shift, a missed exam or a run of days off with fever, stomach upset or a migraine. HR asks so the days count as paid sick leave instead of unpaid or annual leave. Universities ask because absences can affect attendance records and exam eligibility.

Fitness certificates come earlier in the story. A new employer may want one before your start date. A school may ask before a trip or a sports day. A gym, club or race organiser wants proof you can train safely. An airline may ask for a fit to fly note after a recent illness, and the airline still makes its own boarding decision.
Every one of these organisations wants a doctor's written opinion so nobody in the office has to make a medical call.
Two signals tell you which one you need. If the question is about the past, it is sick leave. If it is about what comes next, it is fitness.

blocks.text: Who issues a sick leave or fitness certificate?

A sick leave or fitness certificate on DrCertificate is issued only by an independent doctor with an MBBS, MD or MS qualification. All doctors on the platform are registered with a medical council. The doctor reads your request, asks questions in a digital chat and makes the medical decision.

DrCertificate is the platform in the middle. DrCertificate connects applicants with doctors, runs the form and payment, and sends approved certificates by email. DrCertificate does not diagnose, treat or prescribe.
That split matters.

When HR or a school checks a certificate, the question is whether a qualified, registered doctor stands behind it. Rules on who may certify differ by country. In Singapore, the Ministry of Manpower says an employee qualifies for paid sick leave only when certified unfit for work by a medical practitioner registered under the Medical Registration Act or Dental Registration Act.
Check what your own country and employer require first. DrCertificate encourages every customer to confirm that the place of submission accepts online medical notes before choosing the service.

What should a sick leave or fitness certificate include?

A sick leave or fitness certificate usually shows your full name, the consultation date, the purpose and the doctor's name, qualification and registration details. A sick leave note adds the days you were unfit. A fitness note states what you were found fit for.
Run a short check before you send the PDF.

Ask the organisation about its own format first. An employer may want the file uploaded to an HR portal, and a sports club may insist on its own form. Knowing this before you apply saves trouble, because a certificate cannot be corrected once issued unless the fault came from the medical team.

items: Name and ID Your name and any ID match your official records.
Dates The dates or validity period line up with your absence or your event.
Purpose The certificate type and purpose match what the organisation asked for.
Doctor details The doctor's name, qualification and registration details are visible.

blocks.text: Will your employer or school accept a sick leave or fitness certificate?

Acceptance of a sick leave or fitness certificate is decided by the employer, school or airline that receives it, not by DrCertificate or the doctor. Each organisation sets its own rules on which notes it takes. Ask before you apply, not after.

A certificate gets questioned for a handful of common reasons. The type may be wrong, like a sick leave note sent when HR wanted a fit to work note. Details may be missing or mismatched, or the dates may not match the absence. A company policy may require a doctor from an approved panel. A role may need a physical exam that no online chat can replace.

In the Philippines, the Omnibus Rules that carry out the Labor Code say the physician engaged by an employer under the rule conducts a free pre employment medical examination and a free annual physical examination. An online note does not stand in for that.

If your certificate is questioned, ask the organisation to tell you in writing what it needs. Show the doctor's details printed on the certificate and check that you picked the right form option. If an in person exam is required, book one with a local clinic.
When is an online sick leave or fitness certificate not the right choice?

An online sick leave or fitness certificate is not the right choice when your symptoms are urgent, severe or getting worse. Chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding or a high fever that will not settle need in person or emergency care straight away.

DrCertificate is for suitable non emergency situations only. The doctor may decline any request, and the payment is not refunded when that happens. If you have been ill for more than a week, a doctor who can examine you is the better route.
Other limits apply too.

blocks.text: Sick leave and fitness certificates in Singapore, Malaysia and the rest of South East Asia

Sick leave and fitness certificate rules differ across the 10 South East Asian countries DrCertificate serves, and each employer adds its own policy on top. The service covers Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Brunei. DrCertificate also covers the Philippines, Thailand and Vietnam, along with Cambodia, Laos and Myanmar.
In most of these countries, sick leave and work from home notes go up to 7 days for generic symptoms, and fitness notes are generally valid for 30 days. The doctor still decides each case.

Singapore ties paid sick leave to certification by a registered medical practitioner, and the Ministry of Manpower website sets out the rule. In Malaysia, the Employment Act and your contract set sick leave entitlement. In the Philippines, the Department of Labor and Employment publishes labour rules, including those on medical exams. In every other served country, the national labour or health ministry website is the place to check.
Then confirm with your employer, school or airline before you apply.

Frequently asked questions about sick leave and fitness certificates
Can a sick leave certificate be backdated?

A sick leave certificate covers only the dates the doctor agrees to support. The doctor decides what dates the certificate covers based on what you share in the chat, and may decline dates that do not fit your symptoms. Apply as soon as you fall ill so the dates line up with your absence.
How many days can a sick leave certificate cover?

The doctor decides how many days a sick leave certificate covers, case by case. In most South East Asian countries, sick leave and work from home notes go up to 7 days for generic symptoms. Longer or more serious illness is better handled by a doctor who can examine you in person.
Do I have to talk to the doctor?

Yes, the doctor reviews your request through a digital chat and may ask follow-up questions before deciding. DrCertificate has no video calls or in person consultations. Reply promptly and with honest answers in the chat, because unclear or inconsistent details can slow the decision or lead the doctor to decline.
What happens if the doctor declines my request?

If the doctor declines your request, no certificate is issued and the payment is not refunded. Doctors decline about 2% of requests when the name and ID do not match or the symptoms and details shared are inconsistent. Check every detail on the form before paying to avoid a declined request.
Is a medical certificate necessary for taking one day of sick leave?
Whether a medical certificate is required for a single day of sick leave depends on your employer and country. Singapore links paid sick leave to certification by a registered medical practitioner.
Can I use a fitness certificate for travel?

Yes, a fit to fly certificate uses the Medical Fitness Certificate option on the DrCertificate form. If you need a doctor to state you should not fly, the Unfit to Travel option is the right choice. Check the airline's own rules first, because each airline decides what it accepts.
